en: Vintage colorized postcard showing a large public square filled with people walking and gathering. In the background stand neoclassical buildings with arcades and balconies, palm trees, and a broad open plaza in front. The left side features a larger civic-style building. The right and lower margins are covered with handwritten correspondence. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the location.
